architectural_boundary.runtime_gap: ResidentSession still owns expanded K/V, while CompactResidentCache is deliberately production-unreachable. A runtime layout variant must select compact ownership instead of expanded ownership and bind the live kv_b/o_proj tensors plus stable DSA rank buffer to this proven DAG.
architectural_boundary.why_not_allocate_both: At 32K the expanded K/V core is 312 GiB while compact core is 5.484375 GiB. Side-by-side allocation cannot reach the target and is not admitted.

promotion_gate.reason: The complete attention DAG is proven only on a bounded synthetic fixture. Runtime ownership selection, complete-token parity, and contention-free live evidence are still absent.

live tensor binding and stable DSA-ranked index upload
sustained 2K/8K/32K TTFT, TPS, bytes, commands, memory, swap, and thermal validation
